Prerequisites: Greased Lightning class feature

Land a blow to your target that not even the thickest of armor can endure. You may declare your next unarmed strike on your turn to be a True Strike as a free action, allowing you to resolve that attack against the target's touch AC. You must possess at least two stacks of Greased Lightning before you can activate this talent, both of which are expended once this attack is resolved (even if you miss). This is a Combo Finisher talent.
